messages:
adi: spotted tenant-A QoR regression during canary. evictions + higher mismatch rate. unsure if v2.3.1 introduced regressed kernel or we routed a big-seq variant.

carmen: current rollout metadata only has model_ref+tag. we need variant-level context to debug resource vs quality.

lee: suggestion: add optional deployment tags to rollout manifest: `schema_version`, `binary_variant`, `quant_mode`, `kernel_profile`, `max_sequence`, `deployer_id`. keep optional so old manifests are unchanged.

oliver: add small deploy snapshots: `observed_peak_rss_mb` and `kv_cache_mb` at activation time. lightweight ints for joins.

adi: agree. also include `telemetry_anchor` to link to the telemetry stream for that rollout window for quick joins in postmortems.

carmen: we should define a closed enum for postmortem tagging: `blame_category` values = ["resource_pressure","model_quality","client_behavior","runtime_bug","telemetry_gap"]. rollouts can set `blame_candidates` array.

lee: rollback behavior: human rollback should set `rollback_initiator`, `rollback_reason`, and optional `blame_override` so automated healers understand intent.

adi: migration plan: API accepts `schema_version` (v1|v2). analytics treats missing fields as `unknown`. we should provide a backfill SQL example in RFC for the common cases.

oliver: also recommend a compact `diagnostic_vector` field (small list of short enums) to surface likely causes without free text. keeps analytics clean.

carmen: opt-in fields only. add strict typing in the schema and publish the enum doc. avoid free-form messages.

adi: action items: i will draft RFC patch with fields, example manifest snippet, enum list, and an analytics backfill query. i'll ping SRE for alert threshold tweaks.
